name: Choco Chips
ingredients_raw: Water, Milk Solids, Sugar, Chocochips Compound (4.5%)[Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Antioxidant ( 322), Emulsifier (476), CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA / ETHYL VANILLINE)], Cocoa Solids, Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471, 433), Stabilizers (412, 466, 407). CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS (102, 110, 122, 133) AND ADDED FLAVOUR (NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES-CHOCOLATE).
